quotes.text: A journalist once asked me if fame had changed me and I said yes, now I'm an asshole in nicer shoes. He printed 'the spotlight has refined him.' I will never forgive that man for making me sound reasonable.

quotes.text: People ask why my stand-up is so filthy. Because clean comedy is a goddamn lie, that's why. You ever stub your toe and say 'oh fudge'? No. You say what you say, and that's the only honest moment most people have all day.
